title: Lifetime-valid decisions by continually evolving AI analysts
abstract: arXiv:2610.30562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents increasingly act as analysts whose decision can often be cast as hypothesis tests. Classical tests control the Type I error rate, the probability of rejecting a true null hypothesis, for fixed procedures. However, AI analysts introduce internal randomness and can evolve continuously over time. As AI analysts evolve, the risk of approving versions with Type I error rates above the target can accumulate, and adaptive use of evaluation feedback can lead to overfitting. We introduce continual validation, which evaluates each proposed AI analyst version before deployment using simulated data under the null hypothesis, with scenarios that can be randomized and expanded over time. We prove that, regardless of how updates are chosen or how many are proposed, the lifetime probability of ever deploying a version whose Type I error rate exceeds the allowed level remains bounded. translated_title: 持续演化的AI分析师实现终身有效的决策
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地扮演分析师的角色，其决策通常可以归结为假设检验。经典检验针对固定程序控制第一类错误率，即拒绝真实零假设的概率。然而，AI分析师引入了内部随机性，并且会随时间不断演化。随着AI分析师的演化，批准第一类错误率超过目标水平的版本的风险会不断累积，而对评估反馈的自适应使用可能导致过拟合。我们提出了持续验证方法，在部署前使用零假设下的模拟数据对每个提出的AI分析师版本进行评估，其测试场景可以随时间随机化和扩展。我们证明，无论更新如何选择或提出的更新数量多少，部署第一类错误率超过允许水平的版本的终身概率始终保持有界。这保证了每个后续决策都能控制第一类错误率。
tldr: 提出“持续验证”方法，在部署前使用可随机化和扩展的零假设模拟数据评估每个AI分析师版本，并证明无论更新如何选择，部署第一类错误率超标版本的终身概率始终有界，从而保障持续演化的AI分析师所有后续决策的终身有效性。
en_tdlr: We introduce continual validation, which evaluates each proposed AI analyst version before deployment using randomized and expandable simulated data under the null hypothesis, and prove that the lifetime probability of ever deploying a version whose Type I error rate exceeds the allowed level remains bounded, regardless of how updates are chosen or how many are proposed.
